Land-freight exemptions remain unknown; aviation exemptions are not transferred. Retain March month bounds to July month bounds and the 92–152 calendar-day range. Retain Health and biosecurity / Human disease control as the stated COVID purpose; no additional inferred motive is coded. Sudan Tribune is an announcement report, OCHA a national status report, and IOM the distinct Diffra chronology origin. The latter remains a substantive indexed extract after direct failure; all saved baseline reads are disclosed as reused. Retain unlocated Diffra/Abyei PCA area text with null coordinates.
